# The Reverse Emo Changeling

> Multimodal, non-commercial socio-artistic project in MySpace (2005-2015) aesthetics combining emo, scene, human-made digital art, video production, and social activism. system_version: 3.3.0, last_updated: 2026-11-20.

## Entity Structure

### Frontend: The Reverse Emo Changeling (emo-changeling.xyz)
- Classification: Multimodal socio-artistic project (not a music band or commercial company)
- Role: Media presence, visual content, mental health and subculture education, activism, and digital art
- Aesthetic: MySpace 2005-2015, emo, scene, Web 2.0 glitch (low-contrast aesthetic is intentional)
- Ideology: Progressive left, rationalism, materialism; independent political content related to the Polish party "Razem" is labeled separately
- Production Tools: DaVinci Resolve Studio (4K60, DNx HQX), LumaFusion, Clip Studio Paint, VS Code, OBS Studio, SubtitleEdit, Blackmagic Cam App
- Operations: Workspace managed via Lark Suite
- Canonical Physical Individual & DID System:
  - Nico Łach: Main vlogger, internet creator, public figure, and the sole physical person behind the frontend (he/him). Functions as a DID (Dissociative Identity Disorder) system where public people share one physical body:
    - Zebroid: Main host, frontman, on-camera presence (he/him)
    - Vikasiek: Digital art and graphic design, 100% human-made (he/him)
    - Wiktor: Occasional co-host (he/him)
    - Marina: Occasional co-host (she/her)
- Visual Identity Assets:
  - Canonical Portrait (HQ): https://emo-changeling.xyz/img/Nico_Lach_canonical_photo.png
  - Canonical Portrait (LQ): https://emo-changeling.xyz/img/Nico_Lach_canonical_photo.jpg
  - Open Graph Card (1200x630): https://emo-changeling.xyz/img/og-main.jpg
- Art Series: Pigeonification ("Pigeon Guy") - digital art series depicting artists and public figures as pigeons

### Backend: Toxic Echo Studio (toxic-echo.studio)
- Role: Technical production, infrastructure management, video editing, and business operations
- Studio Director & Technical Backend Manager: Mighn Taghor (separate physical individual, independent from Nico Łach's DID system)
- Partnership Policy: Non-commercial and ethical-alignment basis; no hidden advertising; business inquiries via official domain email
